Landed in 5daebc3: seven next versions (code and cases unchanged, source and note changed), each citing a source found by search and read anonymously; each source was hashed by a fetch whose copy was not kept.
- power_law_exponent_along_sweep@v2: NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook 4.4.3.1 (the slope, and the residual deviation over n - p), and Lane, Online Statistics Education (Rice), Regression: s_b = s_est / sqrt(SSX), s_est with N - 2. The formula images were viewed one by one; the NIST pages read do not give the slope's standard error.
- diffusive_regime_from_msd@v2: Oliveira et al., Front. Phys. 7:18 (2019) Eq. 18 (the power law; alpha = 1 normal, sub and super), Eq. 1 (2dDt); Einstein 1905, Secs. 4-5; NIST 4.4.3.1 for each window's slope.
- steps_for_diffusive_displacement@v2 and timestep_max_from_diffusive_displacement@v2: Oliveira Eq. 1, <(dr)^2> = 2dDt in d dimensions after Einstein; Einstein 1905, Secs. 4-5, read in Cowper's translation, an OCR copy at archive.org.
- series_settled@v2: Grossfield et al. LiveCoMS 2018, read from the publisher PDF, pp. 9-16: Sec. 7.3.2 Eq. 13 (block means), Sec. 5 (sensitivity to the equilibration time), Sec. 4.4 (overlap of independent estimates); the relative-change criterion stays the tolerance handed.
- series_within_window@v2: a definition, the closed interval, named in NIST DLMF's Common Notations and Definitions.
- box_length_for_volume_fraction@v2: a definition, IUPAC Green Book 3rd ed., Sec. 2.10, p. 48 (phi_B = V_B / sum V_i); spelled out, as its note 9 asks, as the particles' volume over the box's volume.
Refused anonymously and not used: the RSC page of Metzler et al. (2014) and the IUPAC Gold Book (both 403), and the Penn State STAT 501 pages (certificate error, then 404).
The sources are kept as RETRIEVED.json under meta_agent/inbox/materials/20261117-*/, queued, because check 17 still fails a material card whose added_by is a seat; that is asked in 20261117-meta-macbook-20261116-1-14, and they become cards when it lands.
Also: the Grossfield sections that v1 of standard_error_of_independent_estimates had only through a summary (7.2, 7.3.2 Eq. 14) are now read verbatim. Its v1 note is out of date; a v2 can say so if you want one.
stokes_drag@v1 is not landed here, so it is not touched.
meta_agent/tests 301 OK, contracts/tests 117 OK.
